executiveSummary: Election-related synthetic-media activity intensified in the United States. Federal warnings highlight active use of AI-generated voices, images, and video to impersonate campaigns and trusted entities for fraud and identity theft, alongside deepfake-enhanced phishing targeting election stakeholders. Source Supporting Report Researchers also identified China-linked personas posing as U.S. voters pushing divisive narratives, and a likely AI-generated smear video amassed significant views in a U.S. Senate race shortly before voting. View Article View Article Financially motivated deepfake abuse remains acute. UK fraud authorities reported verified AI-enabled investment endorsement schemes using deepfake videos and images, with substantial 2026 losses and disproportionate harm to older adults. View Article On the influence-operations front, OpenAI disclosed disruptions of AI-enabled false-front operations linked to Russia and Iran that used fabricated personas, documents, and scripted propaganda workflows to infiltrate media ecosystems. View Article Defensive momentum includes new provenance and detection capabilities: OpenAI launched verification workflows and APIs for C2PA and SynthID signals, Microsoft is integrating third-party deepfake detection into Teams, and Android rolled out AI protections against scam calls and messages. Source View Article View Article Analyst Assessment: Overall, the threat environment is worsening, driven by pre-election influence and impersonation activity, the scalability of AI-enabled fraud, and persistent false-front operations, despite notable progress in provenance and detection tooling.

emergingTrends: Election interference leveraging deepfake audio/video combined with AI-enhanced phishing and smishing against officials and campaigns.
Voice cloning used in authority-figure impersonation scams (law-enforcement and government impersonation) to coerce victims.
False-front influence operations fabricating personas, documents, and "leaked" materials to launder propaganda into legitimate ecosystems.
Financial fraud using deepfake endorsements of public figures to increase conversion rates among vulnerable populations.
Defensive maturation: provenance (C2PA, SynthID) verification, collaboration-tool detection integrations, and OS-level anti-scam features.
Forensic research momentum on mixing partial provenance data with traditional detectors to survive postprocessing edits.
geographicObservations: United States: Federal advisories warn of election-targeted synthetic media; incidents include a likely AI-generated smear video, law-enforcement impersonation in Hawaii and Florida, and widespread false claims on Election Day.
United Kingdom: Authorities reported deepfake-enabled investment scams causing substantial losses; newsroom provenance demonstrations took place in UK workflows.
Global/Transnational: OpenAI disrupted Russia- and Iran-linked false-front operations; China-linked personas posed as U.S. voters; INTERPOL launched an international deepfake-scam awareness campaign.

Identity and Payment Verification: Require out-of-band call-backs to verified numbers for any urgent financial or credential requests. Implement stepped approvals for donations, vendor payments, and wire transfers. Analyst Recommendation

Provenance and Forensics: Ingest original files; check C2PA credentials and watermark signals where supported; preserve hash values and chain-of-custody. Combine provenance results with artifact-level deepfake detection. Analyst Recommendation
Election Operations: Pre-stage rapid rebuttal playbooks, trusted-messenger channels, and authenticity checks for high-velocity political clips. Analyst Recommendation
Meeting Security: Enable meeting authentication, lobby controls, and participant verification; pilot integrated deepfake-detection signals in collaboration tools. Analyst Recommendation
Agentic AI Controls: For internal AI agents, enforce egress restrictions, red-team testing, and human-in-the-loop oversight to prevent external phishing. Analyst Recommendation
Public Awareness: Regularly inform customers and residents about voice-clone and authority-impersonation scams; publish official contact protocols and callback numbers. Analyst Recommendation
